q175.from:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (ch.entity_id)
    ch.entity_id,
    ch.tenant_id,
    (ch.before_data->>'stage_id') AS before_stage_id
  FROM change_history ch
  JOIN lost_opps lo ON lo.id = ch.entity_id AND lo.tenant_id = ch.tenant_id
  WHERE ch.entity_table = 'opportunities'
    AND 'stage_id' = ANY(ch.changed_columns)
  ORDER BY ch.entity_id, ch.occurred_at DESC
q175.to:
SELECT entity_id, tenant_id, before_stage_id
  FROM (
    SELECT
      ch.entity_id,
      ch.tenant_id,
      (ch.before_data->>'stage_id') AS before_stage_id,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ch.entity_id ORDER BY ch.occurred_at DESC) AS rn
    FROM change_history ch
    JOIN lost_opps lo ON lo.id = ch.entity_id AND lo.tenant_id = ch.tenant_id
    WHERE ch.entity_table = 'opportunities'
      AND 'stage_id' = ANY(ch.changed_columns)
  ) ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
